mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_tbl (userId, title, content, postCodeId, createAt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{postCodeId}, NOW());
INSERT INTO postRecommendation_tbl (postId, userId, reactionType, createAt) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{reactionType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.postId, p.userId, u.nickName, p.title, p.content, p.createAt, p.viewCount, p.postCodeId, pc.category as postCategory, p.likeCount, p.dislikeCount FROM post_tbl p JOIN user_tbl u ON p.userId = u.userId JOIN postCode_tbl pc ON p.postCodeId = pc.postCodeId WHERE p.postId = #{postId}
SELECT postAttachmentId, postId, userId, attachmentUrl, originalFileName, contentType FROM postAttachment_tbl WHERE postId = #{postId};
SELECT postRecommendationId, postId, userId, reactionType, createAt FROM postRecommendation_tbl WHERE postId = #{postId} AND userId = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM postRecommendation_tbl WHERE postId = #{postId} AND userId = #{userId}
